accessNotes: DOMAIN: both thefundedtrader.com and thefundedtraderprogram.com resolve and serve a BYTE-IDENTICAL homepage (241,435 bytes, verified with cmp). thefundedtraderprogram.com is canonical: the mirror's own wp-json oembed links self-reference thefundedtraderprogram.com, and the checkout dashboard, help subdomain and treasure-hunt subdomain all live under thefundedtraderprogram.com. JS-GATING: the on-page challenge configurator at https://thefundedtraderprogram.com/#challenge-v2 renders every value as a '-' placeholder in the static HTML; nothing is server-rendered. Resolved by reading the widget's own loader (challenge-script.js line 110: const jsonUrl = '/wp-content/themes/tft-theme/assets/challenge-v2/challenge-v2.2-dataset.json') and fetching that dataset - a public 819 KB file on the firm's own domain, and the exact source the public pricing widget renders from. Every figure recorded here comes from it. HELP CENTRE DEAD: help.thefundedtraderprogram.com returns HTTP 404 'Not found' on every URL including its root and all per-challenge 'Comprehensive Guide' articles that the homepage and the dataset itself link to (verified: Knight Pro 9930524, Royal 6293542, Royal Pro 10309003, Standard 6082934, payouts/scaling 9206586). intercom.help/thefundedtrader also 404s. WebFetch additionally got HTTP 403 on that subdomain; curl with a browser User-Agent got through to a genuine 404, confirming the content is gone rather than merely bot-blocked. Consequence: base profit split, overnight-holding rules, consistency rules and fee refundability could NOT be verified against an official source and are left null. STALE MARKETING: the homepage comparison table claims '$100k Challenge Price $489' for TFT, which matches NO product in the live dataset (100k prices are Knight $299, Knight Pro $349, Classic 1-Step $499, Royal $600, Royal Pro $319, Classic 2-Step $479, Dragon $299). The $489 figure was NOT used. PRODUCT SET: the live dataset sells 7 products. The 'Standard' and 'Rapid' challenges referenced in older TFT material are NOT in the current dataset; two 'Classic' products (1-Step and 2-Step) are new and are not mentioned in the homepage FAQ copy. ASSET CLASS: FAQ states 'This typically includes forex, commodities, indices, and crypto' on cTrader/Match-Trader/DXtrade -> recorded as cfd.
